title: hibiscus aristatus
intro: Hibiscus aristatus, commonly known as the Bunga Raya or Hibiscus sabdariffa, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and aiding in weight loss, due to its high content of antioxidants and other bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of H. aristatus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of H. aristatus include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
